source_name: SAMLHOC / France Phaléristique — Madagascar commemorative medals
scope_rule: Started from the SAMLHOC medal index, followed only the Madagascar entry's explicit main page, medal object subpages and shared diploma subpage, and cached the directly linked legal-notice page solely to record rights. No broad SAMLHOC crawl or unrelated Colonial Medal expansion was performed.

source_pages.result: Current index lists the Madagascar commemorative-medal entry for the first and second expeditions; used as the directory boundary.

source_pages.role: Madagascar main history and legal text
source_pages.result: Main page title/date, 1883–1886 and 1894–1895 histories, physical descriptions, common ribbon, first-medal oval suspension, 1895 clasp, and transcribed 1886/1896/1897 legal text captured.
Page heading explicitly identifies the first expedition and labels the complete source image Avers/Revers.
Page heading explicitly identifies the second expedition and labels the complete source image Avers/Revers.
Shows the first-expedition diploma labelled remis en 1886 and the second-expedition diploma labelled remis en 1898; image contribution credited to Cyrille Cardona.

SAMLHOC states that it owns or holds usage rights for site text/images and prohibits reproduction, representation, modification or publication without prior written permission; no open reuse licence found.

candidate_difference_summary.note: Both rows belong to the existing FRA-III-MADAGASCAR-COMMEMORATIVE family in local/source-atlas data. They are two major expedition variants (1886 and 1896 legal creation), not two new families. This package is raw-source coverage only and does not merge public volumes.

image_audit.audit_method: Each original JPEG was downloaded once from the URL exposed in its SAMLHOC page, decoded with System.Drawing, visually opened at original resolution, and SHA-256 hashed. The two medal images show complete obverse/reverse pairs; the two diploma images are retained as documents and are not counted as medal objects. No thumbnail, screenshot, generated image, or wrong-clasp image was used.

failures.result: The web renderer timed out on the four direct media clicks, but direct terminal requests to the exact source URLs succeeded and all four files decoded and were visually checked; no page was counted as unavailable.

The SAMLHOC main page transcribes Journal officiel laws, decrees, circular and parliamentary debates but exposes no direct law-page hyperlinks in the Madagascar entry. This package records the transcriptions and exact references without claiming an independent primary-scan verification.

Both complete medal pair files are below the preferred 1200 px long-edge priority (360 px and 427 px); they remain complete low-resolution source references and should not be treated as high-resolution publication masters.
No open reuse licence was stated. SAMLHOC legal notice requires prior written permission for reproduction/adaptation; the cache is for research provenance.

next_checkpoint: Current SAMLHOC Madagascar index, main page, first/second object pages, shared diploma page and rights page are cached and swept. Two existing-family variant rows are complete at the source-evidence level. Next work, if authorized, should independently locate higher-resolution object photographs or primary Journal officiel scans; do not broaden this package to unrelated SAMLHOC pages.
